events.title: Anti-AI Backlash Becomes a Campaign Platform
events.description: Moratoriums on data centres, restrictions on AI in schools and hiring, and protection for displaced workers move from the fringe to the platform, on both left and right. Polling shows the position is popular well beyond the activists, and candidates who hedged start to reposition.

events.title: Security Hawks Set the Terms
events.description: Both campaigns converge on the position that the United States must win, that the lead is fragile, and that anything shared with anyone is a lead surrendered. Arguments for restraint are recast as arguments for losing.
